newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL COMMUNICATIONS MINISTER FINE AFTER SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL COMMUNICATIONS MINISTER FINE AFTER SURGERY.

text.p: Brazilian Communications Minister Sergio Motta was in stable condition Friday after undergoing surgery to remove a benign tumor from his appendix, hospital authorities said.
The Albert Einstein hospital in Sao Paulo said tests had confirmed the tumor was benign.
"He showed good recovery during immediate post-surgery, with his clinical condition stable," it said in a statement.
Motta also underwent a final phase of dental surgery.

In the absence of Motta, officials at the Communications Ministry opened bids Friday morning for two more Band B cellular concessions -- Sao Paulo state and an area comprising the northeastern states of Alagoas, Ceara, Paraiba, Pernambuco, Piaui and Rio Grande do Norte.
A key but controversial member of President Fernando Henrique Cardoso's cabinet, Motta underwent heart surgery last year.
